summary.summary:
* IOM has released its Strategic Plan for Ethiopia for 2025–2029, contributing to the humanitarian situation update. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168831)

* Meeting minutes from the Logistics Cluster in Addis Ababa on July 29, 2025, provide an update on the humanitarian situation in Ethiopia. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168773)

* Meeting minutes from the Logistics Cluster in Addis Ababa on July 15, 2025, offer insights into the humanitarian situation in Ethiopia. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168760)
⚕️
* The WHO has developed a health emergency investment case for Ethiopia spanning May to December 2025, detailing the humanitarian health situation. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168738)

* The World Food Programme's May 2025 Country Brief provides an update on the humanitarian situation in Ethiopia. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168507)

* Ethiopia continues to face high food assistance needs in July 2025 due to ongoing weather shocks and tensions in the northern regions. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168471)

* IOM's analysis of community feedback and referrals in Ethiopia from April to June 2025 updates on the humanitarian situation. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168410)

* Conflict-induced displacement continues to impact Ethiopia, as highlighted in the ECHO Daily Flash of July 31, 2025, providing a humanitarian situation update. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4168245)

* UN OCHA released an update on July 29, 2025, detailing the humanitarian response in Ethiopia for the year 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167767)

* Ethiopian farmers are adopting revamped, age-old growing practices described as "life-changing," as reported by the World Food Programme, contributing to the humanitarian situation. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167221)

* A UN monitoring group warns of unfolding famine in Gaza, with the WFP noting similarities to past famines seen in Ethiopia and Biafra. [Source](https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w172zss5zzsrb7r)
